fields.name: label
fields.label: Label / question
fields.description: The question or label the visitor sees. For Heading and Paragraph, this is the text shown.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Field name
fields.description: Optional. The key used when the form is submitted (e.g. groupSize). Auto-generated from the label if left blank. Give all options of one radio/checkbox group the SAME field name.

fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Placeholder
fields.description: Optional hint text shown inside empty text/number/date fields.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Options
fields.description: For Radio / Checkbox / Dropdown only. List the choices separated by a pipe |  e.g.  Yes|No|Maybe . To store a different submitted value, use Label=value  e.g.  New Zealand=nz|Overseas=intl

fields.name: required
fields.label: Required
fields.description: Visitor must complete this field before submitting.

fields.name: action
fields.label: Action URL (Submit button only)
fields.description: Only used on the Submit button. The endpoint the form POSTs to when submitted.

fields.name: confirmation
fields.label: Confirmation page (Submit button only)
fields.description: Optional. Page to redirect to after a successful submission.
